text:
priya: starting preflight for 02:00 UTC window. Targets: API v3.1.0, runtime 3.8.0-quant, console 2.3.0, router 4.5.0. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Canary plan: 5% for 15m -> 25% for 30m -> full. No tenant pin. @nikhil (runtime) @emma (router) ack blockers now.

nikhil: ack. Runtime 3.8.0 enables a fused attention kernel (attn-fused=true) and exposes a KERNEL_HINT header for opportunistic qkernels. For the canary i'd prefer to suppress the header and use runtime:3.8.0-nohint to avoid any config-driven perf divergence.

emma: ack. Router 4.5.0 includes a header rename and a new envoy filter (edge-shim). For safety we'll deploy canary with ROUTER_RENAME=false and FILTER_SAFE=true. Also note new image increased epoll threads by +1; watch socket latencies.

deploybot: queued wave rw-17999. Canary config attached: {
  "pct": 5,
  "stages_mins": [15, 30],
  "abort_conditions": ["p99>800ms","5xx>0.25%","token_lat_increase"]
}

priya: proceed with runtime:3.8.0-nohint and router env overrides. SRE: monitor p50/p95/p99, 5xx, token generation latency, and memory pressure. If p99>800ms or 5xx spike abort.

emma: applying env override for router canary:
```
kubectl set env deployment/router-canary ROUTER_RENAME=false FILTER_SAFE=true --namespace=prod-canary
```

deploybot: canary start triggered at 02:03 UTC. Rolling sequence: api -> runtime:3.8.0-nohint -> router (overrides) -> console. Rolling to 5%.

deploybot: 5% reached at 02:18 UTC. Short checks: health endpoints 200/200, but token p99 creeping to ~820ms. Runtime logs show attn kernel fallback warnings on a pod: 
```
[02:19:12] WARN attn_fallback model=rw-small reason=memory_pressure pod=runtime-21
```

nikhil: that's odd for the nohint tag; fallback happens when fused kernel can't allocate scratch memory. Looks like canary pod memory cgroup is tighter than stable nodes. I'm seeing runtime-21 at 93% RSS. Two options: increase canary pod memory to match stable or rollback runtime to 3.7.2 while we investigate.

priya: pause any ramp. Emma, hold router ramp. SRE please confirm memory metrics across canary nodes.

sre-bot: memory snapshot: runtime-21 cgroup ~95% of request, other runtime canary pods ~60-70%. Node reserved memory similar to stable. No node restarts or OOMs. Recommendation: increase runtime canary pod memory by +1Gi for the affected pool OR rollback runtime to 3.7.2 for canary subset.

emma: we should avoid infra churn mid-window. Suggest rollback runtime to restore baseline latency while owners sort resource mismatch.

nikhil: agreed. Initiating targeted rollback to runtime:3.7.2 on the canary subset now. Command: 
```
deploybot rollback component=runtime target=3.7.2 wave=rw-17999 initiated_by=nikhil
```

deploybot: rollback acknowledged and in progress. Pausing ramp. Notifying release channel.

deploybot: rollback complete at 02:31 UTC. Runtime back to 3.7.2 on canary subset. Canary paused at 5%. Post-rollback p99 reduced to ~730ms, token latencies stabilized.

priya: good quick rollback. Action items from this window: 1) ensure canary pod resource requests/limits match stable pool (ops/sre), 2) add attn_fallback as a canary abort metric, 3) add a deploybot preflight that verifies runtime variant memory config and pool selectors before ramp, 4) document FILTER_SAFE usage for router edge-shim. We'll reschedule after fixes.

emma: filing PR to document filter flags and keep FILTER_SAFE=true for the next rollout.

nikhil: i'll add attn_fallback into runtime health counters and open a follow-up to coordinate memory sizing for canary pools. Also will add a knob to avoid lazy fused allocation under low-cgroup headroom.

deploybot: wave rw-17999 closed (paused) at 02:35 UTC. Notifications posted to release doc.

release-bot: created follow-up ticket RW-17999-FOLLOWUP and assigned to ops/sre/runtime teams.

priya: thanks everyone for the quick coordination. I'll update the release notes and schedule a follow-up preflight after the resource alignment is done. :raised_hands:
